name: Greenidge Power Plant and Data Center

profile.research_note:
Company existence corroborated indirectly via the Support.com reverse takeover; the Yates County power plant/bitcoin mining facility itself not directly confirmed this session. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.

[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is in Yates County, New York, attributed to Greenidge Generation Holdings Inc., a cryptocurrency mining and power generation company. A dedicated Wikipedia article for Greenidge Generation Holdings was not found this session, but a related Wikipedia fetch for Support.com, a Delaware headquartered technology support company originally founded in 1997, confirmed that Greenidge Generation Holdings acquired Support.com in a reverse takeover on September 15, 2021, and later sold Support.com to RealDefense LLC in July 2023, corroborating Greenidge existence as a real, publicly documented cryptocurrency mining and power company, consistent with its industry reputation for operating a converted power plant in the Dresden, Yates County, New York area for bitcoin mining. This research did not independently confirm the specific power plant conversion history, capacity, or current operational status of the Yates County facility itself. No building specific address or MW figures were located in available sourcing this session.
